description: Why: deprecated API calls produce compiler warnings, and the replacement API (DateTime::from_timestamp_millis) is more semantically correct for millisecond timestamps. What: gc_report.rs ms_to_datetime calls chrono::DateTime::from_timestamp(ms / 1000, 0) which is deprecated in chrono 0.4.31+. Use DateTime::from_timestamp_millis(ms) instead, which avoids the manual division and handles leap seconds correctly.
title: gc_report ms_to_datetime uses deprecated DateTime::from_timestamp
